subject: Experience needs: reps.run()/mount() -> RepSession, plus progress aggregation and installed rule
body: For the Rep screen I need reps.run(profile, emotionId, trigger) -> RepSession (or mount(el, props) with onDone). It should play the anchor, then body, focus, words, then rate 0 to 10 before and after, with honest sham handling. For Progress I need a pure function over the RepSession log: reps per emotion, intensity trend, cue vs sham recovery, and the installed rule. Demo rep length is about 30 s.
